PreToolUse.command:
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '[.. | .command? // empty] | map(select(length > 0)) | join(" ")' 2>/dev/null); case "$CMD" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) echo '{}'; exit 0;; esac; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; DIFF=$(git -C "$REPO" diff --cached); PATTERN='-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|(api|secret|access)[_-]?key["'''"]?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*["'''][A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}["''']'; FOUND=$(printf '%s' "$DIFF" | grep -inE -e "$PATTERN" | head -5); if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then printf 'Potential hardcoded secret found in staged changes — commit blocked:
%s

Remove the secret (use an env var instead) or confirm with the user this is a false positive before retrying.' "$FOUND" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo '{}'
